instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Civil engineering firm executing public infrastructure tenders including bridge rehabilitation, water treatment plants, and road widening projects. We operate our own heavy equipment fleet of 45 machines. Evaluation of telematics-based predictive maintenance is underway to reduce critical equipment downtime caused by unexpected mechanical failures.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have never run a formal innovation initiative. Problems are solved ad-hoc as they arise, usually by the most directly affected team member. There is no dedicated budget or structured ideation process; efforts focus purely on meeting immediate operational demands rather than forward-looking experimentation.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base, meaning our top three clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health; we need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including modular construction systems or specialized infrastructure consulting that leverages our existing heavy equipment capabilities.
answers.additionalContext: The construction labor market is highly volatile, and the regulatory compliance burden for public works projects frequently changes, which adds significant operational complexity without providing an opportunity for proactive innovation.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.

opportunities.title: Telematics Integration for Efficiency Gains
opportunities.rationale: Implementing the predictive maintenance system already being evaluated offers immediate operational efficiency improvements and reduces costly unplanned downtime. This is a low-risk incremental step that optimizes current assets.

first_actions: Pilot telematics software on 5 key heavy machines
Conduct internal training for maintenance staff
Secure small allocation from annual operational budget
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in unplanned equipment downtime by 15%
milestones: Full rollout to the fleet by Year 1 end

opportunities.title: Modular Infrastructure Package Development
opportunities.rationale: To achieve diversification, Fusion Systems should explore developing standardized, modular construction components (e.g., pre-fab bridge segments or water treatment modules) that can be deployed faster and serve multiple smaller projects. This taps into new market opportunities outside of large, traditional tender cycles.

first_actions: Conduct feasibility study on modular design for water systems
Identify one specialized consulting partner in prefabricated construction
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure two pilot modular project contracts within 2 years
milestones: Feasibility study completion by Year 1 end
Launch first modular prototype testing by Year 2 end

next_steps.action: Establish a rudimentary, low-cost ideation framework (e.g., monthly brainstorming sessions)
Formalize the business case for the modular construction diversification strategy and present it to the formal committee

key_weaknesses: Absence of a structured innovation process leading to reactive, ad-hoc problem-solving.
Low digital maturity (Level 1) severely limiting data utilization for predictive maintenance and operational optimization.
Strong reliance on a concentrated customer base creating significant revenue concentration risk.
Minimal dedicated budget allocation hindering the exploration of long-term radical diversification opportunities.
